messages:
nina: I pushed a short playbook PR that groups streaming 429 + timeout fallbacks, context-trim notes, and SDK snippets for resume/dedupe. PTAL :wave:

cal: link? want to confirm what we tell users to do when they see a mid-stream 429 vs a sync 429. Important for SDK behavior.

nina: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1204. TL;DR in doc: sync 429 = reject (backoff + honor Retry-After); mid-stream 429/trailer or abrupt abort = treat as overload signal, record resume cursor and resume later; server crash (502/504) = retry from application checkpoint.

reza: please be explicit about not recommending naive "resend last N tokens". add an at-most-once pattern using app-level commit ids + an idempotent prompt tail. customers keep double-billing otherwise. :warning:

nina: added a compact pattern and tiny pseudo-snippet (python + node). snippet: ```python
# pseudo resumable pattern
resp = client.stream(prompt, headers={"x-stream-cursor": cursor})
for ev in resp:
    if ev.cursor <= last_committed:
        continue
    buffer += ev.text
    last_committed = ev.cursor
```

sophia: editorial: wrap header names in code spans (`Retry-After`, `x-stream-cursor`) and add one-line "Deployment differences" (Hosted may return immediate 429s; Dedicated can queue/hold requests).

nina: updated formatting and added Deployment differences with link to dedicated docs. Also added short migration guidance: "SDKs should expose explicit resume APIs and disable implicit auto-reconnect for streams."

cal: CI?

docs-bot: CI checks started for PR #1204  link: https://ci.internal.redwood/1600.

reza: ops ask: mention trailers not reaching some proxies/mobile clients. recommend emitting an explicit final close event with resume_cursor in-band if trailers aren't reliable.

nina: added a final-close-event pattern and a tiny ws snippet showing in-band resume metadata.

sophia: LGTM small copy edits. merge after CI. :shipit:

docs-bot: PR #1204 merged by sophia at 1987654380.
